# Temple Scroll Column 20 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** 11Q19 (Cave 11), Col. 20 | **Condition:** well preserved

---

**20:1** And you shall put all these upon the palms of Aaron and upon the palms of his sons,

**20:2** and you shall wave them as a wave offering before Me.

**20:3** And you shall take them from their hands and make them smoke upon the altar, upon the burnt offering,

**20:4** for a soothing aroma before Me; it is a fire offering to the LORD.

**20:5** And you shall take the breast of the ram of the ordination that is for Aaron and wave it as a wave offering before Me,

**20:6** and it shall be for you as a portion.

**20:7** And you shall consecrate the breast of the wave offering and the thigh of the contribution

**20:8** that was waved and that was lifted up from the ram of the ordination, from that which is for Aaron and from that which is for his sons.

**20:9** And it shall be for Aaron and for his sons as a perpetual due from the sons of Israel.

**20:10** You shall ordain them for seven days; each day a young bull for a sin offering for atonement.

**20:11** And you shall purify the altar when you make atonement upon it, and you shall anoint it to consecrate it.

**20:12** Seven days you shall make atonement upon the altar and consecrate it,

**20:13** and the altar shall be most holy; whatever touches the altar shall become holy.

**20:14** And this is what you shall do upon the altar: two lambs, sons of a year, perpetually, each day.

**20:15** The one lamb you shall make in the morning, and the second lamb you shall make between the evenings.

**20:16** And a tenth of fine flour mixed with beaten oil, a fourth of a hin; and a drink offering, a fourth of a hin of wine, for the one lamb.

---

*EMET notes: Column 20 is well preserved. It completes the ordination ceremony (20:1-9) and prescribes the seven-day installation period (20:10-12), paralleling Exodus 29:24-37. The column then transitions to the daily perpetual offering (olat ha-tamid, 20:14-16), paralleling Exodus 29:38-40. "Wave offering" (tenufah) preserved literally — the horizontal presentation gesture before the deity. "Contribution" (terumah) — the vertical lifting gesture. "Between the evenings" (bein ha-arbayim) preserved as a technical chronological term.*
